easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Marvin using Chainer's ability by discarding a card, allowing you to cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marvin, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Marvin from your graveyard by paying {2}.
When Marvin enters the battlefield, Chainer triggers, giving Marvin haste until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Loran's ability by tapping it, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Repeat.
